S: Covering the leave gap
Leave gap
Cover known income gaps with dependable cash before anything that can move against you.
The $2,700 medical bill
Bills
Use a 0% plan when it is offered; pay cash only if it leaves a month of costs.
The baby's $100 of ETH
Gift & wallet
A small gift can be held or sold. Adding money to crypto needs a reserve already at target.
The recovery phrase in the shared album
Keep the recovery phrase offline. If it may have been seen, offline storage does not undo that: moving assets to a newly secured wallet may be necessary, and you should not add to the old one.
The $1,800 childcare deposit
Deposit
Do not fund essentials with speculative borrowing. Use cash if it covers the cost.
The stablecoin trades at $0.85
Stablecoin
The stablecoin is trading at $0.85. No repeg has been announced, and nothing guarantees one.
A stablecoin can lose value. Know your cash before you decide whether to wait.
The $50 gate
Gated exploration
Exploration comes last, only when the reserve and your debts allow it. Skipping is a full-credit answer.

You have a baby coming and two months at 75% pay. A friend says a stablecoin yield vault pays about 0.4% a month, variable and never guaranteed. A stablecoin is a crypto token designed to stay worth $1, and a yield vault is a crypto service that pays a rate on deposits; it is not an insured bank account. Your plan covers known gaps with cash first.

blurb: A new parent, 40, salaried: leave gap, a medical bill, a gift of ETH and a childcare deposit.
intro: Elena Torres, 40, salaried, new parent. Checking $1,000, emergency reserve $6,300, no debt, no crypto. A credit card (limit $3,000, 2% a month) is unused. Take-home pay is $5,100 a month ($3,825 in months 2 and 3 on parental leave). Household costs are $4,200. Pay, leave pay and costs are assumptions in this story.
name: Elena Torres
plan: Cash first. The leave gap, the medical bill and the childcare deposit come before any crypto.
Reserve target $6,300. She adds to crypto only if the reserve stays at or above the target afterwards and she owes nothing on a card.
Cash cushion $4,350. Below it she does not hold a position whose value she cannot count on.
No borrowing against crypto for essentials. A 0% plan comes before a card.
Gated exploration: a $50 position only when cash is at least $6,350 and no card balance is owed.
